snippet.title: Vic-20 - Polaris
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
You command the submarine maneuvering away from enemy subs, bombs and the ocean bottom. Launch your missiles and destroy the squadrons of attacking aircraft. Be prepared for the enemy dive bomber. Pilot your sub through the underwater mine field. Shoot the mines if you are quick enough. 16 levels of game play in total.
